SPROUT · DIGITAL LOAN ORIGINATION · THAILAND 🇹🇭

Borrow responsibly. Decide with confidence.

A complete mobile loan-origination system rendered as realistic iPhone captures (393×852), grouped by user lane. Built to Thai AML/CFT and Bank of Thailand Responsible-Lending norms — e-KYC, NCB credit-bureau consent, DSR ≤ 70%, EIR disclosure, sanctions/PEP/FATCA screening, AML risk rating and maker–checker governance. Every flow shows the happy path and its failure branch.
